pipeline_schema_notes: Signal JSONL fields: ts (ISO8601 UTC), source_type, source_name, url, text, geo [lat,lon], entities, lang, kind_hint, credibility, signal_id. Loaded into watchtower.models.Signal; Signal.ts becomes unix seconds internally. EventCluster fields consumed by briefs.py and the TUI: severity, severity_score, components, exposure, analogs, briefs.
pipeline_sync_points: replay JSONL schema <-> sources.py loader <-> models.Signal
pipeline_extra_checks: Timestamps: JSONL uses ISO8601 UTC strings; models use unix seconds — verify conversion at the source boundary. Empty replay file or zero matching chokepoints must log a warning, not silently produce a zero-severity event.
